text:
maria.chen: Heads up — CVE triage for the new OpenSSL/glibc reports. Planning a reproducible rebuild + staged canary for both ubuntu-22.04 and alpine:edge images. Need quick alignment on signer RBAC, audit logging retention, and rollback criteria.

raj.patel: ack. can you share the exact CVEs and whether they require ABI bumps or just patch backports?

maria.chen: CVE-2026-XXXX (libssl buffer handling) — patchable on ubuntu-22.04 via libssl 3.1.x backport. CVE-2026-YYYY (glibc allocator path) — higher risk, might require a full libc rebuild for some base images. Alpine's musl + openssl combo has a separate advisory (ALP-2026-01) that can be patched without musl bump but needs verification.

liam.fox: For glibc ones, we should avoid forced glibc major bumps in prod images unless absolutely necessary. Propose: 1) rebuild ubuntu base with patched libssl, 2) run canary fleet with checksum & attestation, 3) only roll glibc bump if validation failures or exploit PoC emerges.

sarah.kim: +1. We also need to ensure the image signing flow uses KMS signing keys rotated per-release. Current signer-role in CI is too broad — we should tighten to image-signer@infra with ephemeral invocation tokens and audit logs forwarded to sec-logs.

raj.patel: Agreed. Two RBAC asks: a) create image-signer role with permission only to call kms.sign and attest/signing service; b) disallow promote-to-stable unless the PR has a signed SBOM and passing canary sig-checks.

sec-bot: deploy-checker: previous canary (2026-05-08) passed smoke for x86_64 but failed image-verify on arm64 due to musl-compat mismatch. See run: https://internal/runs/7891

maria.chen: Good catch, sec-bot. We need cross-arch checks in the pipeline and the attestation must include arch-specific checksum. Add a gating job `verify:attest:arch` in CI.

liam.fox: For promotion metadata I propose we record: base-image-hash, sbom-s3-path, kms-signature, promoted-by, canary-region-list. Keep that as immutable labels in the registry manifest.

raj.patel: How long should audit logs for signer activity be retained? Security wants 13 months for compliance, infra prefers 90 days due to cost. Can we archive to cold storage (S3 Glacier) after 90 days and keep a searchable index for 13 months?

sarah.kim: That approach works — we need to ensure the archived index retains enough context (signer identity, request payload hash, timestamp). Also add a periodic integrity check job to verify archived log checksums.

maria.chen: Back to rollout — propose phased canary: 5% traffic region-A (24h), 10% region-B (24h), 25% multiregion (48h), then promote. Fail criteria: any crash rate >0.5% or new 5xx class increase >0.2% or image verify failures. Rollback plan: immediate traffic divert to previous signed manifest + revoke new tag from staging registries.

liam.fox: Question: runtime image verifier (agent) needs to be tolerant to signature key rotation. How do we handle KMS key rotation without causing verifier failures?

raj.patel: Verifier should accept a keyset: current + last-2 rotated keys. Store public keyset in config service with versioned metadata. During rotation, publish new public key first, wait 1 canary window, then deprecate oldest.

maria.chen: Also: we must add an audit event when a revert is triggered that ties back to the canary metric state and person who approved/automated the revert. This event should be pushed to the incident channel and the compliance audit index.

sec-bot: incident-helper: auto-created revert ticket #SEC-4521 when canary threshold crossed in region-A at 2292345699. Link: https://internal/incidents/SEC-4521

liam.fox: Small CI snippet for the `verify:attest:arch` job we can add to dot-ci:

jobs:
  verify_attest_arch:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - run: docker pull $IMAGE
      - run: cosign verify --keyset $KEYSET_JSON $IMAGE
      - run: ./verify-arch-checksum.sh $IMAGE $EXPECTED_ARCH

raj.patel: Nice. One more: stamping immutable `repro-build-id` into the image labels is critical for blamelist and for reproducing builds later. Keep it as `repro-build-id=<git-sha>-<timestamp>-<builder-id>`.

maria.chen: Action items: 
- raj: create RBAC change request for `image-signer` with least privilege and PR workflow.
- liam: add `verify:attest:arch` CI job + manifest labels and docs.
- sarah: design audit-archive lifecycle (90d hot -> cold to 13mo) and integrity check job.
- maria: draft canary windows and rollback playbook plus incident correlation events.

raj.patel: I'll file the RBAC RFC today and tag infra/security reviewers.

liam.fox: I'll open the CI PR and include cross-arch smoke jobs. ETA EOD tomorrow.

sarah.kim: Will produce audit lifecycle doc by EOW.

maria.chen: thanks all. If anyone sees a downstream service that relies on older musl/glibc behavior, ping me before we promote. :pray: 

sec-bot: reminder: sign-off checklist template created at https://internal/docs/signing-checklist (auto-post)
